lines.text: If a crowd turns into a riot, the biggest danger often isn't the violence. It's the crowd itself.

phrases.text: If a crowd turns into a riot,
the biggest danger often isn't the violence.

lines.text: Step one: leave early. The moment it turns,/ walk away. Don't stop to film.

phrases.text: The moment it turns,/ walk away. Don't stop to film.

lines.text: Stay at the edges. Avoid walls, fences and narrow streets: that's where people get crushed.

phrases.text: Avoid walls, fences and narrow streets: that's where people get crushed.

lines.text: If the crowd surges, don't fight it. Go with it, and drift sideways between waves.

phrases.text: Go with it, and drift sideways between waves.

lines.text: Arms up, like a boxer. Protect your chest, so you can keep breathing.

phrases.text: Protect your chest, so you can keep breathing.

lines.text: If you fall, get up fast. If you can't, curl up on your side and cover your head.

phrases.text: If you fall, get up fast.
If you can't, curl up on your side and cover your head.

lines.text: Tear gas? Move upwind and uphill. Don't rub your eyes: flush them with water.

phrases.text: Don't rub your eyes: flush them with water.

lines.text: Once you're out, get indoors, away from windows.
Have you ever been in a crowd that turned? Tell me in the comments.

phrases.text: Have you ever been in a crowd that turned?
